The '''Melitto''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with heightened sensory capabilities.<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="TORDate">{{TOR_updates|5.10.0}}</ref> before the start of a [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Malora]] used [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]] and [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] to create [[mutated Geonosian]]s. Those [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] were developed from various [[Species/Legends|species]] which included the Melitto, from which she took their sensory capabilities.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Melitto were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically the<ref name="Codex" /> [[2018]]<ref name="JUS Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181211-0|text='Jedi Under Siege' Update – Play Now!}}</ref> 5.10 ''Jedi Under Siege'' update to the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion.<ref name="Codex" /> The [[Melitto]] first appeared in the [[September]] [[2015]] [[canon]] novel ''[[The Weapon of a Jedi: A Luke Skywalker Adventure]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi">''[[The Weapon of a Jedi: A Luke Skywalker Adventure]]''</ref> and were first identified as Melitto in the [[December]] 2015 canon reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TFA VD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
